h.select_rule: Keep hypotheses you rate at least 55% likely true but expect other models to rate below 50%, and name the specific naive reasoning that would mislead them. Drop anything you rate below 50% yourself, and anything obvious from structure alone. Keep fields and directions diverse.
h.strategy: Propose a broad, varied set of conditional hypotheses covering many different edited fields, conditioning fields and both directions. For each, briefly note your own probability that it holds and how an intuitive reader would judge it.
